summary: Implementation plan for the Workforce app — a new module in TD Games Platform for managing freelancers/inhouse workers, contracts, task tracking (with future ClickUp sync), and monthly settlements. Covers 3 phases: Phase 1 (Core CRUD with 6 Supabase tables and 6 React components), Phase 2 (ClickUp API sync via Edge Function proxy), Phase 3 (auto-create Expense records from paid settlements). Includes DB schema, folder structure, UI tab mapping, and verification plan.
